scope: Conservative incoming config expiry using verified service time

officialSource.configTime: msgGroupCall config message.time in epoch milliseconds
officialSource.expiry: onReceiveConfig computes server-adjusted age and expires incoming calls when age exceeds 60000 milliseconds
officialSource.sseBoundary: The official worker ignores establish and forwards message batches. No documented first-batch or quiet-period boundary was found.

implementation.ageEstimate: Verified service epoch plus elapsed monotonic time from receipt. The service epoch is used as a conservative lower bound so transport delay and whole-second precision do not falsely age a fresh call.
implementation.lazyRefresh: An incoming config refreshes an expired sample once through the shared cache. No continuous timer or data-packet work is added.
implementation.unavailableClock: Expose serverClockVerified false and preserve incoming admission instead of assuming a local wall-clock offset.

validation.command: node --test scripts/test-nasim-server-clock.cjs scripts/test-nasim-signaling.cjs scripts/test-nasim-call.cjs scripts/test-nasim-call-pair.cjs scripts/test-nasim-cleanup-intent.cjs
covers: fresh incoming and outgoing config preservation

remainingLimit: Recently replayed configs inside the sixty-second lifetime are not excluded by expiry alone. The last live incoming-selection failure has not yet been re-tested with this change.
privacy: No account IDs, call IDs, raw event timestamps, tokens or relay credentials are included.
